definitions.explanation: Established or operated by a city government. Used primarily for institutions such as schools, hospitals, libraries, and parks.

examples.japanese: {市立|しりつ}{図書館|としょかん}で{本|ほん}を{借|か}りた。
examples.english: I borrowed a book from the city library.

examples.japanese: {娘|むすめ}は{市立|しりつ}の{中学校|ちゅうがっこう}に{通|かよ}っている。
examples.english: My daughter goes to a municipal junior high school.

examples.japanese: この{市立|しりつ}{病院|びょういん}は{地域|ちいき}{医療|いりょう}の{中心|ちゅうしん}として{重要|じゅうよう}な{役割|やくわり}を{果|は}たしている。
examples.english: This city hospital plays an important role as the center of regional healthcare.

notes:
Because {市立|しりつ} and {私立|しりつ} are homophones, speakers sometimes disambiguate by reading {市立|しりつ} as いちりつ in conversation. This is especially common when discussing schools.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {市立|しりつ}{病院|びょういん}: city hospital
- {市立|しりつ}{図書館|としょかん}: city library
- {市立|しりつ}{小学校|しょうがっこう}: city elementary school
- {市立|しりつ}{美術館|びじゅつかん}: city art museum

RELATED WORDS:
- {私立|しりつ}: private (homophone — distinguished as しりつ vs. わたくしりつ in speech)
- {国立|こくりつ}: national (government-run)
- {県立|けんりつ}: prefectural
- {公立|こうりつ}: public (general term for government-run institutions)
- {府立|ふりつ}: established by an urban prefecture (Osaka/Kyoto)
- {都立|とりつ}: established by Tokyo Metropolitan Government
